answer: Every crossing of the erg is rationed by the water book. Each skin is issued at the well, weighed at the start and again at the grove of every halt, and a skin that loses weight too fast is cut open to find the leak. A cedar skin bought at a market fails the book: its seams were never tested at the well, and the ration master refuses it at the first halt. Faking a ration means bribing the water master, forging forty days of weighings and paying 9,400 in bribes, while the vertex entry in the book is read at every oasis, so a second caravan claiming the same skins is turned back.
